releaseNotes:
• 10m & 5m Quota Warnings: Timely notifications delivered when approaching daily limits with persistence and at-most-once daily delivery
• Daily Limit Enforcement & Keyboard Bypass Fix: Resolved IME soft-keyboard interruption to maintain persistent blocking across repeated reopenings
• 5-Minute Break Countdown Across Screen-Off: Real elapsed-time break countdown that continues in background, wakes on expiry, and recovers across device reboot
